alex: Morning team — quick triage sweep. Queue ~48 (↑6). Not seeing a new spike but a couple of webhook errors from Checkout service.
maya: Thanks. Any customer-facing incidents?
sam: I can take webhook one. I'll shadow with ops-bot logs. @deploy-bot can you recheck last deploy to payments-proxy?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: last deploy to payments-proxy at 2823452000 by lee — no errors in deploy logs.
lee: I rolled a hotfix yesterday but not to payments-proxy. I can roll a patch now if you want me to.
sam: Please do. Also heads up — a macro `refund_flow_v2` mismatch in templates causing wrong wording in outbound emails. CS is flagging it.
maya: :eyes: I'll edit the macro. Proposed change: update greeting + add `{{refund_eta}}`. Will push and ping for review.
jin: I reviewed CS-3421 thread; adding a defensive check to webhook handler is a quick win. PR at https://git.company/pr/5123
alex: Nice. Can someone LGTM the PR? low-risk. Also need a short blurb for the support macros doc so we don't lose the wording change.
lee: On it. @maya once you update macro can you drop the before/after snippet here? support will want to audit.
maya: Copy — pushing change now. snippet: ```refund_flow_v2: 'We're processing your refund. ETA: {{refund_eta}}'```
alex: :thumbsup: after deploy, please update the macros index (docs/support/macros.md) and add version tag `v2-2026-03`
jin: PR merged for webhook defensive check. Sam can you validate with the repro steps in CS-3421?
sam: Running through it — can't reproduce after merge. Will mark ticket as 'pending customer confirmation' and update macros.
ops-bot: ops-bot: Alert cleared for payments-webhook-fault at 2823456700 — no further errors in last 10m.
alex: Thanks. Volume note: embeddings-related tickets (search mismatches) up from 1 -> 5 this morning; hypothesizing a quantization rollout on dedicated nodes. Eng-ml please take a look when you can.
maya: Filed ENG-7265 with perf traces, cc eng-ml @sam to add sample payloads.
sam: Assigned ENG-7265 to eng-ml. I'll attach logs in the ticket.
lee: Logistics: I'm off from 2026-03-18 to 2026-03-22. Leaving handoff doc at /docs/handoffs/lee-march18.md
alex: Noted. For today's shift: sam handling payments, maya handling macros + CS comms, jin monitoring webhook logs, lee doing hotfix if needed. If anything critical escalte to #eng-oncall.
maya: One more — can someone bump macro TTLs? Support says some macros are failing after 24h. I suspect stale cache. @eng-infra?
jin: I'll open an infra ticket, INFRA-314. Short term flush cache for macros cache key `macros-v1`.
alex: Great. Thanks team. I'll send a short summary to support-ops and close this thread.
